question: Which of the following cellular components are known as the protein factories of a cell?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ribosomes.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ribosomes **are known as the **protein factories of a cell,** as they are responsible for **protein synthesis.**
 
• They are present in both **prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells,** and can be found in the** cytoplasm** or attached to the endoplasmic reticulum.
 
• Ribosomes are composed of** two subunits, **a large and small subunit, that work together to read the **genetic code** and **assemble amino acids** into proteins.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mitochondria** is known as the **powerhouse of the cell**.

 
 
• It is responsible for producing energy in the form of **ATP.**
 
 
 
• **Golgi bodies** are responsible for modifying, sorting, and packaging **proteins and lipids f**or transport to their final destination.
 
• **Chloroplasts** is present in **plant cells.**
 
 
• It is responsible for** photosynthesis** and the production of** glucose.**
